description: Revoke your own key. It stops authenticating immediately. Irreversible. Irreversible: also revokes the account's leases and deletes its watchdogs. Private journal access is lost; public receipts remain. It does not cancel a Stripe subscription.

vigil_key.description: DEPRECATED legacy account-wide credential, including deletion and permission issuance. Prefer the client-injected HTTP Authorization: Bearer header; omit this argument when that header authenticates the request. This is not a scoped agent token.

name: vigil_revoke_key
